[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#purpose-statement]

### Purpose Statement

This standard defines mandatory requirements for provisioning, configuring, and managing event broker infrastructure (AWS MSK, Amazon MQ, Amazon ElastiCache) that supports the Enterprise Eventing as a Service (EaaS) platform. This standard is the infrastructure counterpart to application integration standards.
page_texts.6:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#scope]

### Scope

**In Scope**:
- AWS MSK (Kafka) cluster provisioning and configuration
- Amazon MQ (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ) broker provisioning
- Amazon ElastiCache (Redis Streams) cluster provisioning
- Network configuration (VPC, subnets, security groups, PrivateLink)
- IAM authentication and authorization configuration
- TLS encryption configuration
- High availability and disaster recovery configuration
- Monitoring and alerting configuration

**Out of Scope**:
- Application-level consumer/producer implementation (see STD-APP-INT-001, STD-APP-INT-002)
- Schema registry configuration (covered in EaaS white paper)
- Lenses.io management platform configuration (see ADR-IFR-008)

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#req-ifr-int-001-004-network-configuration]

#### REQ-IFR-INT-001-004: Network Configuration

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Secure network isolation and connectivity

**Requirements**:
- Deploy brokers in private subnets
- Configure security groups with minimal required ports
- Use VPC PrivateLink for cross-account access
- Enable VPC flow logs for network monitoring

**Implementation**:
```hcl
# Security Group for MSK Cluster
resource "aws_security_group" "msk" {
  name_prefix = "eaas-msk-${var.environment}-"
  description = "Security group for MSK cluster"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  ingress {
    description = "Kafka plaintext from VPC"
    from_port   = 9092
    to_port     = 9092
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  ingress {
    description = "Kafka TLS from VPC"
    from_port   = 9094
    to_port     = 9094
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  ingress {
    description = "Kafka IAM from VPC"
    from_port   = 9098
    to_port     = 9098
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  ingress {
    description = "Zookeeper from VPC"
    from_port   = 2181
    to_port     = 2181
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  ingress {
    description = "JMX Exporter"
    from_port   = 11001
    to_port     = 11001
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  egress {
    description = "Allow all outbound"
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name = "eaas-msk-sg-${var.environment}"
  })

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# VPC Endpoint for MSK (PrivateLink)
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "msk" {
  count = var.enable_privatelink ? 1 : 0

  vpc_id              = var.vpc_id
  service_name        = "com.amazonaws.${var.aws_region}.kafka"
  vpc_endpoint_type   = "Interface"
  subnet_ids          = var.private_subnet_ids
  security_group_ids  = [aws_security_group.msk_endpoint[0].id]
  private_dns_enabled = true

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name = "eaas-msk-endpoint-${var.environment}"
  })
}

resource "aws_security_group" "msk_endpoint" {
  count = var.enable_privatelink ? 1 : 0

  name_prefix = "eaas-msk-endpoint-${var.environment}-"
  description = "Security group for MSK VPC endpoint"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  ingress {
    description = "HTTPS from VPC"
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name = "eaas-msk-endpoint-sg-${var.environment}"
  })
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#req-ifr-int-001-006-amazon-elasticache-redis-streams-configuration]

#### REQ-IFR-INT-001-006: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis Streams) Configuration

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Redis Streams for lightweight event streaming

**Requirements**:
- Provision ElastiCache Redis 7.0+ with cluster mode enabled
- Configure minimum 3 shards across 3 AZs
- Enable automatic failover and backup
- Use cache.r6g.large instance type minimum

**Implementation**:
```hcl
resource "aws_elasticache_replication_group" "redis" {
  replication_group_id       = "eaas-redis-${var.environment}"
  replication_group_description = "Redis cluster for event streaming - ${var.environment}"
  engine                     = "redis"
  engine_version             = "7.0"
  node_type                  = "cache.r6g.large"

  num_cache_clusters         = 3
  automatic_failover_enabled = true
  multi_az_enabled          = true

  subnet_group_name         = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.redis.name
  security_group_ids        = [aws_security_group.redis.id]

  at_rest_encryption_enabled = true
  transit_encryption_enabled = true
  auth_token_enabled        = true
  auth_token                = aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.redis_auth.secret_string

  kms_key_id                = aws_kms_key.redis.arn

  snapshot_retention_limit  = 7
  snapshot_window          = "03:00-05:00"
  maintenance_window       = "sun:05:00-sun:07:00"

  auto_minor_version_upgrade = true

  parameter_group_name     = aws_elasticache_parameter_group.redis.name

  log_delivery_configuration {
    destination      = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.redis_slow.name
    destination_type = "cloudwatch-logs"
    log_format       = "json"
    log_type         = "slow-log"
  }

  log_delivery_configuration {
    destination      = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.redis_engine.name
    destination_type = "cloudwatch-logs"
    log_format       = "json"
    log_type         = "engine-log"
  }

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name        = "eaas-redis-${var.environment}"
    Environment = var.environment
    Component   = "cache-streams"
  })
}

resource "aws_elasticache_subnet_group" "redis" {
  name       = "eaas-redis-subnet-${var.environment}"
  subnet_ids = var.private_subnet_ids
}

resource "aws_elasticache_parameter_group" "redis" {
  name   = "eaas-redis-params-${var.environment}"
  family = "redis7"

  parameter {
    name  = "maxmemory-policy"
    value = "allkeys-lru"
  }

  parameter {
    name  = "timeout"
    value = "300"
  }
}

resource "aws_security_group" "redis" {
  name_prefix = "eaas-redis-${var.environment}-"
  description = "Security group for ElastiCache Redis"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  ingress {
    description = "Redis"
    from_port   = 6379
    to_port     = 6379
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name = "eaas-redis-sg-${var.environment}"
  })
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "redis" {
  description             = "KMS key for ElastiCache encryption - ${var.environment}"
  deletion_window_in_days = 30
  enable_key_rotation     = true
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#req-ifr-int-001-007-monitoring-and-alerting]

#### REQ-IFR-INT-001-007: Monitoring and Alerting

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Operational visibility and proactive incident response

**Requirements**:
- Export broker metrics to CloudWatch
- Configure Lenses.io for Kafka monitoring (see ADR-IFR-008)
- Set up alerts for: broker CPU > 80%, disk > 85%, consumer lag > 10k messages
- Integrate with PagerDuty for critical alerts

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# CloudWatch Log Groups
resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "msk" {
  name              = "/aws/msk/eaas-${var.environment}"
  retention_in_days = 30
  kms_key_id        = aws_kms_key.msk.arn
}

resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "redis_slow" {
  name              = "/aws/elasticache/redis/eaas-${var.environment}/slow-log"
  retention_in_days = 7
}

resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "redis_engine" {
  name              = "/aws/elasticache/redis/eaas-${var.environment}/engine-log"
  retention_in_days = 7
}

# MSK CloudWatch Alarms
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "msk_cpu" {
  alarm_name          = "msk-cpu-${var.environment}"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "CpuUser"
  namespace           = "AWS/Kafka"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 80
  alarm_description   = "MSK broker CPU usage above 80%"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]

  dimensions = {
    "Cluster Name" = module.msk_cluster.cluster_name
  }
}

resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "msk_disk" {
  alarm_name          = "msk-disk-${var.environment}"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 1
  metric_name         = "KafkaDataLogsDiskUsed"
  namespace           = "AWS/Kafka"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 85
  alarm_description   = "MSK disk usage above 85%"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]

  dimensions = {
    "Cluster Name" = module.msk_cluster.cluster_name
  }
}

resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "kafka_consumer_lag" {
  alarm_name          = "kafka-consumer-lag-${var.environment}"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "EstimatedMaxTimeLag"
  namespace           = "AWS/Kafka"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Maximum"
  threshold           = 10000
  alarm_description   = "Kafka consumer lag above 10k messages"
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]

  dimensions = {
    "Cluster Name"  = module.msk_cluster.cluster_name
    "Consumer Group" = var.consumer_group_name
  }
}

# SNS Topic for Alerts
resource "aws_sns_topic" "alerts" {
  name              = "eaas-broker-alerts-${var.environment}"
  kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.sns.id

  tags = merge(var.common_tags, {
    Name = "eaas-broker-alerts-${var.environment}"
  })
}

resource "aws_sns_topic_subscription" "pagerduty" {
  count     = var.enable_pagerduty ? 1 : 0
  topic_arn = aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn
  protocol  = "https"
  endpoint  = var.pagerduty_endpoint
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#req-ifr-int-001-008-high-availability-configuration]

#### REQ-IFR-INT-001-008: High Availability Configuration

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Meet 99.9% availability SLA

**Requirements**:
- Deploy brokers across 3 Availability Zones
- Configure replication factor 3 for critical topics
- Configure min.insync.replicas = 2 for production topics
- Implement automated failover with maximum 5-minute RTO

**Implementation**:
```hcl
# Multi-AZ Topic Configuration
resource "kafka_topic" "critical_events" {
  name               = "eaas.critical.events"
  replication_factor = 3
  partitions         = 12

  config = {
    "min.insync.replicas" = "2"
    "retention.ms"        = "604800000" # 7 days
    "compression.type"    = "lz4"
    "cleanup.policy"      = "delete"
  }
}

# Application Auto Scaling for MSK Storage
resource "aws_appautoscaling_target" "msk_storage" {
  max_capacity       = 10000
  min_capacity       = 1000
  resource_id        = module.msk_cluster.arn
  scalable_dimension = "kafka:broker-storage:VolumeSize"
  service_namespace  = "kafka"
}

resource "aws_appautoscaling_policy" "msk_storage_scaling" {
  name               = "msk-storage-scaling-${var.environment}"
  policy_type        = "TargetTrackingScaling"
  resource_id        = aws_appautoscaling_target.msk_storage.resource_id
  scalable_dimension = aws_appautoscaling_target.msk_storage.scalable_dimension
  service_namespace  = aws_appautoscaling_target.msk_storage.service_namespace

  target_tracking_scaling_policy_configuration {
    target_value = 70.0
    predefined_metric_specification {
      predefined_metric_type = "KafkaBrokerStorageUtilization"
    }
  }
}

# Route53 Health Checks for Broker Endpoints
resource "aws_route53_health_check" "msk_broker" {
  count             = 3
  type              = "CALCULATED"
  child_health_threshold = 1
  child_healthchecks = [
    aws_route53_health_check.msk_broker_tcp[count.index].id
  ]

  tags = {
    Name = "msk-broker-${count.index}-health-${var.environment}"
  }
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#req-ifr-int-001-010-cost-optimization-configuration]

#### REQ-IFR-INT-001-010: Cost Optimization Configuration

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Optimize infrastructure costs per ADR-IFR-008 TCO targets

**Requirements**:
- Use Savings Plans or Reserved Instances for predictable workloads
- Enable broker storage auto-scaling to avoid over-provisioning
- Configure topic retention based on data lifecycle requirements
- Implement cost allocation tags per business unit

**Implementation**:
```hcl
# Cost Allocation Tags
locals {
  cost_tags = {
    "CostCenter"     = var.cost_center
    "BusinessUnit"   = var.business_unit
    "Environment"    = var.environment
    "Application"    = "event-broker"
    "ManagedBy"      = "terraform"
    "Project"        = "eaas"
    "Owner"          = var.owner_email
  }
}

# Savings Plan Configuration (Manual - Document Only)
# Recommended: Compute Savings Plans for 1-year term
# Expected savings: 17-20% vs On-Demand
# Commitment: $X,XXX/month based on baseline usage

# Topic Retention Policies by Data Lifecycle
resource "kafka_topic" "transactional_events" {
  name       = "eaas.transactional.events"
  partitions = 12

  config = {
    "retention.ms"     = "86400000"    # 1 day for transactional
    "retention.bytes"  = "1073741824"  # 1 GB per partition
    "cleanup.policy"   = "delete"
    "compression.type" = "lz4"         # Better compression ratio
  }
}

resource "kafka_topic" "audit_events" {
  name       = "eaas.audit.events"
  partitions = 6

  config = {
    "retention.ms"     = "2592000000"   # 30 days for audit
    "retention.bytes"  = "5368709120"   # 5 GB per partition
    "cleanup.policy"   = "delete"
    "compression.type" = "lz4"
  }
}

resource "kafka_topic" "archival_events" {
  name       = "eaas.archival.events"
  partitions = 3

  config = {
    "retention.ms"     = "31536000000"  # 365 days for archival
    "retention.bytes"  = "10737418240"  # 10 GB per partition
    "cleanup.policy"   = "delete"
    "compression.type" = "zstd"         # Maximum compression
  }
}

# Cost Monitoring Budget
resource "aws_budgets_budget" "broker_monthly" {
  name              = "eaas-broker-monthly-${var.environment}"
  budget_type       = "COST"
  limit_amount      = var.monthly_budget_limit
  limit_unit        = "USD"
  time_period_start = "2024-01-01_00:00"
  time_unit         = "MONTHLY"

  cost_filter {
    name = "TagKeyValue"
    values = [
      "user:Application$event-broker",
      "user:Environment$${var.environment}"
    ]
  }

  notification {
    comparison_operator        = "GREATER_THAN"
    threshold                  = 80
    threshold_type            = "PERCENTAGE"
    notification_type         = "ACTUAL"
    subscriber_email_addresses = [var.budget_notification_email]
  }

  notification {
    comparison_operator        = "GREATER_THAN"
    threshold                  = 100
    threshold_type            = "PERCENTAGE"
    notification_type         = "FORECASTED"
    subscriber_email_addresses = [var.budget_notification_email]
  }
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#31-required-infrastructure-services]

### 3.1 Required Infrastructure Services

**AWS MSK**:
- Kafka version: 3.6+ with KRaft mode
- Instance types: m5.large, m5.xlarge, m5.2xlarge
- Storage: EBS gp3 with auto-scaling

**Amazon MQ**:
- RabbitMQ version: 3.12+
- ActiveMQ version: 5.17+ (legacy systems only)
- Instance types: mq.m5.large, mq.m5.xlarge

**Amazon ElastiCache**:
- Redis version: 7.0+ with Redis Streams
- Instance types: cache.r6g.large, cache.r6g.xlarge
- Node configuration: 3+ shards, 1+ replica per shard

### 3.2 Infrastructure as Code

```hcl
# Complete Event Broker Infrastructure Module
# File: modules/event-broker/main.tf

module "msk_cluster" {
  source = "./modules/msk"

  cluster_name           = "eaas-msk-${var.environment}"
  kafka_version          = "3.6.0"
  number_of_broker_nodes = var.broker_count
  instance_type          = var.broker_instance_type

  vpc_id             = var.vpc_id
  private_subnet_ids = var.private_subnet_ids
  vpc_cidr           = var.vpc_cidr

  enable_iam_auth        = true
  enable_privatelink     = var.enable_privatelink
  enable_audit_logs      = var.enable_audit_logs

  storage_volume_size = var.storage_volume_size

  tags = local.cost_tags
}

module "amazon_mq" {
  source = "./modules/mq"

  broker_name        = "eaas-mq-${var.environment}"
  engine_type        = "RabbitMQ"
  engine_version     = "3.12.13"
  host_instance_type = var.mq_instance_type

  vpc_id             = var.vpc_id
  private_subnet_ids = var.private_subnet_ids
  vpc_cidr           = var.vpc_cidr

  admin_username     = var.mq_admin_username
  enable_audit_logs  = var.enable_audit_logs

  tags = local.cost_tags
}

module "elasticache_redis" {
  source = "./modules/redis"

  cluster_id         = "eaas-redis-${var.environment}"
  engine_version     = "7.0"
  node_type          = var.redis_node_type
  num_cache_clusters = var.redis_cluster_count

  vpc_id             = var.vpc_id
  private_subnet_ids = var.private_subnet_ids
  vpc_cidr           = var.vpc_cidr

  enable_auth_token      = true
  enable_encryption      = true
  snapshot_retention     = 7

  tags = local.cost_tags
}

module "monitoring" {
  source = "./modules/monitoring"

  msk_cluster_name     = module.msk_cluster.cluster_name
  msk_cluster_arn      = module.msk_cluster.arn

  redis_cluster_id     = module.elasticache_redis.cluster_id

  alert_sns_topic_arn  = aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn
  enable_pagerduty     = var.enable_pagerduty
  pagerduty_endpoint   = var.pagerduty_endpoint

  tags = local.cost_tags
}

module "disaster_recovery" {
  source = "./modules/dr"

  source_msk_cluster_arn = module.msk_cluster.arn
  target_region          = var.dr_region

  ecs_cluster_id         = var.ecs_cluster_id
  vpc_id                 = var.vpc_id
  private_subnet_ids     = var.private_subnet_ids

  enable_mirrormaker     = var.enable_dr
  backup_retention_days  = 30

  tags = local.cost_tags
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#msk-cluster-provisioning-template]

### MSK Cluster Provisioning Template

```hcl
# Example: Production MSK Cluster Deployment
# File: environments/production/msk.tf

module "production_event_broker" {
  source = "../../modules/event-broker"

  environment = "production"
  aws_region  = "us-east-1"

  # Network Configuration
  vpc_id             = data.aws_vpc.main.id
  private_subnet_ids = data.aws_subnets.private.ids
  vpc_cidr           = data.aws_vpc.main.cidr_block

  # MSK Configuration
  broker_count          = 6  # 2 brokers per AZ across 3 AZs
  broker_instance_type  = "kafka.m5.2xlarge"
  storage_volume_size   = 2000  # GB per broker

  # Amazon MQ Configuration
  mq_instance_type = "mq.m5.large"
  mq_admin_username = "admin"

  # ElastiCache Configuration
  redis_node_type      = "cache.r6g.xlarge"
  redis_cluster_count  = 3

  # Feature Flags
  enable_privatelink = true
  enable_audit_logs  = true
  enable_pagerduty   = true
  enable_dr          = true

  # DR Configuration
  dr_region = "us-west-2"
  ecs_cluster_id = aws_ecs_cluster.main.id

  # Cost Allocation
  cost_center   = "ENG-001"
  business_unit = "Platform Engineering"
  owner_email   = "platform-engineering@example.com"

  # Alerting
  pagerduty_endpoint = data.aws_ssm_parameter.pagerduty_webhook.value
  budget_notification_email = "cloud-finance@example.com"
  monthly_budget_limit = "15000"
}

output "msk_bootstrap_brokers" {
  value     = module.production_event_broker.msk_bootstrap_brokers_tls
  sensitive = true
}

output "msk_zookeeper_connection" {
  value     = module.production_event_broker.msk_zookeeper_connect
  sensitive = true
}

output "amazon_mq_endpoint" {
  value = module.production_event_broker.mq_broker_endpoints
}

output "redis_endpoint" {
  value = module.production_event_broker.redis_endpoint
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#elasticache-redis-cluster-provisioning-template]

### ElastiCache Redis Cluster Provisioning Template

```hcl
# Example: ElastiCache Redis Cluster with Streams Support
# File: environments/production/redis.tf

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "redis_auth" {
  name_prefix             = "eaas-redis-auth-"
  recovery_window_in_days = 7
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "redis_auth" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.redis_auth.id
  secret_string = random_password.redis_auth.result
}

resource "random_password" "redis_auth" {
  length  = 32
  special = false  # Redis auth tokens cannot contain special characters
}

resource "aws_elasticache_replication_group" "production_redis" {
  replication_group_id          = "eaas-redis-production"
  replication_group_description = "Redis cluster for event streaming - production"
  engine                        = "redis"
  engine_version                = "7.0"
  node_type                     = "cache.r6g.xlarge"
  port                          = 6379

  # Multi-AZ with automatic failover
  num_cache_clusters         = 3
  automatic_failover_enabled = true
  multi_az_enabled           = true

  # Network Configuration
  subnet_group_name          = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.redis.name
  security_group_ids         = [aws_security_group.redis.id]

  # Encryption
  at_rest_encryption_enabled = true
  transit_encryption_enabled = true
  auth_token_enabled         = true
  auth_token                 = aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.redis_auth.secret_string
  kms_key_id                 = aws_kms_key.redis.arn

  # Backup Configuration
  snapshot_retention_limit   = 7
  snapshot_window            = "03:00-05:00"
  maintenance_window         = "sun:05:00-sun:07:00"
  final_snapshot_identifier  = "eaas-redis-production-final-snapshot"

  # Updates
  auto_minor_version_upgrade = true
  apply_immediately          = false

  # Parameter Group
  parameter_group_name       = aws_elasticache_parameter_group.redis7.name

  # Logging
  log_delivery_configuration {
    destination      = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.redis_slow.name
    destination_type = "cloudwatch-logs"
    log_format       = "json"
    log_type         = "slow-log"
  }

  log_delivery_configuration {
    destination      = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.redis_engine.name
    destination_type = "cloudwatch-logs"
    log_format       = "json"
    log_type         = "engine-log"
  }

  tags = {
    Name         = "eaas-redis-production"
    Environment  = "production"
    Component    = "cache-streams"
    CostCenter   = "ENG-001"
    BusinessUnit = "Platform Engineering"
  }
}

resource "aws_elasticache_subnet_group" "redis" {
  name       = "eaas-redis-subnet-production"
  subnet_ids = data.aws_subnets.private.ids
}

resource "aws_elasticache_parameter_group" "redis7" {
  name   = "eaas-redis-params-production"
  family = "redis7"

  # Optimized for Redis Streams
  parameter {
    name  = "maxmemory-policy"
    value = "allkeys-lru"
  }

  parameter {
    name  = "timeout"
    value = "300"
  }

  parameter {
    name  = "tcp-keepalive"
    value = "300"
  }
}

output "redis_primary_endpoint" {
  value = aws_elasticache_replication_group.production_redis.primary_endpoint_address
}

output "redis_reader_endpoint" {
  value = aws_elasticache_replication_group.production_redis.reader_endpoint_address
}
```

[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#broker-patching]

#### Broker Patching

- Schedule maintenance windows during low-traffic periods
- Use rolling updates to maintain availability
- Validate broker health after each broker restart
page_texts.29:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#capacity-planning]

#### Capacity Planning

- Monitor broker CPU, memory, disk metrics daily
- Scale brokers proactively when sustained CPU > 70%
- Review topic partition distribution monthly
page_texts.31:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#broker-outage]

#### Broker Outage

1. Check CloudWatch alarms and Lenses.io alerts
2. Verify broker health in AWS Console
3. Execute failover to standby broker if needed
4. Engage Platform Engineering on-call if issue persists > 15 minutes
page_texts.32:
[standards/infrastructure/integration/STD-INFRA-INT-001-event-broker-integration.md#consumer-lag-spike]

#### Consumer Lag Spike

1. Identify lagging consumer groups in Lenses.io
2. Check application logs for processing errors
3. Scale consumer instances if throughput issue
4. Engage application team if application error

### 6.1 Validation Checklist

- [ ] MSK cluster provisioned with Kafka 3.6+ and KRaft mode
- [ ] IAM authentication enabled and configured
- [ ] TLS encryption enabled for transit and at rest
- [ ] Brokers deployed across 3 Availability Zones
- [ ] Amazon MQ brokers provisioned with HA configuration
- [ ] ElastiCache Redis clusters configured with cluster mode
- [ ] CloudWatch monitoring and alarms configured
- [ ] Lenses.io integrated for Kafka monitoring
- [ ] Cross-region DR replication configured
- [ ] Cost allocation tags applied
- [ ] Network security groups configured with minimal access
- [ ] Operational runbooks documented
